_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: goldens list
cli_commands.description: List registered template-pristine golden scenarios

cli_commands.name: goldens get
cli_commands.description: Show one golden by slug

cli_commands.name: goldens register
cli_commands.description: Register a golden (--slug --template --version --path)

cli_commands.name: goldens update
cli_commands.description: Patch a golden's path and/or template version

cli_commands.name: goldens delete
cli_commands.description: Delete a golden (--yes to confirm)

cli_commands.name: goldens regenerate
cli_commands.description: Regenerate a golden's on-disk tree from its pinned template (--yes to confirm)

cli_commands.name: manifest list
cli_commands.description: List all stored (skill_id, golden_slug) manifests

cli_commands.name: manifest get
cli_commands.description: Show one manifest by (skill_id, golden_slug)

cli_commands.name: manifest upsert
cli_commands.description: Create or replace a manifest (--skill --golden [--allow] [--wildcard-allowed] [--convergence] [--template-version] [--skill-version])

cli_commands.name: manifest clear-stale
cli_commands.description: Clear staleness override for a (skill, golden) manifest (--skill --golden)

cli_commands.name: skill-catalog sync
cli_commands.description: Pull current skills from prompt-manager and reconcile the local mirror

cli_commands.name: skill-catalog list
cli_commands.description: List mirrored skills

cli_commands.name: skill-catalog get
cli_commands.description: Show one mirrored skill by id

cli_commands.name: staleness list
cli_commands.description: List manifests whose pinned versions drift from current

cli_commands.name: record list
cli_commands.description: List terminal validation records (paginated, with optional filters)

cli_commands.name: record get
cli_commands.description: Show one validation record by id

cli_commands.name: validation start
cli_commands.description: Queue a new (skill|tool, golden) validation run

cli_commands.name: validation get
cli_commands.description: Show one validation run by id

cli_commands.name: validation list-active
cli_commands.description: List runs whose status is not terminal

cli_commands.name: report golden-summary
cli_commands.description: Show latest verdict per skill and tool for a golden

cli_commands.name: report tuple-history
cli_commands.description: Paginated record history for one tuple (--skill | --tool, --golden)

cli_commands.name: report coverage
cli_commands.description: Per-skill coverage grid for one golden

cli_commands.name: report skill-fitness
cli_commands.description: Cross-golden trust/cost/convergence aggregate for one skill
